# UCM — Unified Context Management

> A reference architecture for reliable knowledge in agentic AI.

UCM composes three production-validated techniques from adjacent domains into a unified framework:

1. **Calibrated Trust** (Layer 1) — Bayesian multi-source fusion inspired by Google's Knowledge Vault (KDD 2014). When the system outputs confidence 0.96, empirical accuracy is 0.96.

2. **Change Awareness** (Layer 2) — Graph-distance impact propagation inspired by Meta's predictive test selection (ICSE-SEIP 2019). 33% of tests catch 99.9% of real failures.

3. **Targeted Revalidation** (Layer 3) — Volatility classification and incremental re-computation inspired by Rust's Salsa engine (2019+). ~0ms revalidation for 90%+ of queries.

## Implementation
7 open-source Rust crates on crates.io: ucm-graph-core, ucm-events, ucm-ingest, ucm-reason, ucm-observe, ucm-api, ucm-cli.

## Bundled with Krava
UCM is packaged as a portable context module within the Krava SDK — enabling privacy-sovereign, model-agnostic context across applications. Krava provides passkey auth, encrypted memory, and agentic routing.
